name: Halo
notes: Inspiration: one calm, watchful presence (HAL-9000 / arc-reactor adjacent) — translated, not copied: a single ring is both Pulse and Bridge in one motif, not two separate devices. At rest it's a perfect circle (the identity mark, pulse.insetPct is 0 because it isn't corner-anchored — it sits centered or wherever the main object is). When a beat needs a cause→effect, the same ring deforms into an arc reaching toward the effect object, then relaxes back to a circle. Fan is disabled: a single ring can't reach toward several things in different directions at once without losing the 'one calm presence' feeling — use Chain (fired sequentially) instead when a beat seems to call for Fan. The most universal of the three presets: works across any subject, least visually opinionated, recommended as the primary default.
